reason: The idea of one brief that every builder bids on would save me the mess I had last time, but I have only ever hired through people I know, and a platform I have never heard of asking me to put my money through it makes me suspicious. I would need to see who the builders are and what happens to my money before I pay anyone a fee.
objection: Bids from different firms never describe the same work, so how do I compare them? And if the money goes through a platform, who is responsible when the job overruns or the builder walks away?
would_change_my_mind: A standard written scope that every bid must price line by line, plus payment held by the platform and released only stage by stage after I sign off each stage, with builders I can check against past clients.
